module_summary: Pipelined 8-bit unsigned multiplier: registered operands feed shifted partial products, summed in two registered adder-tree stages, with a 3-bit enable shift chain gating the output.

anchors.name: mul_en_in
anchors.why: Input enable; gates operand registers and enters the enable delay chain.

anchors.name: mul_en_out
anchors.why: Output valid flag from the end of the enable delay chain.

anchors.name: mul_out
anchors.why: 16-bit product output, loaded from mul_out_reg when enabled.

anchors.name: mul_en_out_reg
anchors.why: 3-stage enable shift chain tracking valid through the pipeline.

anchors.name: mul_a_reg
anchors.why: Stage-1 multiplicand register feeding partial products.

anchors.name: mul_b_reg
anchors.why: Stage-1 multiplier register; its bits select partial products.

anchors.name: temp
anchors.why: Shifted partial products of mul_a_reg gated by mul_b_reg bits.

anchors.name: mul_out_reg
anchors.why: Stage-3 register holding the full product sum.

groups.name: Enable pipeline
groups.description: Shift chain delaying mul_en_in to mul_en_out and gating output.

groups.name: Partial product and adder tree
groups.description: Partial products, registered pair sums, final sum and gated output.
